name: Fiend
spark: The mote is warm to hold a hand near. It leans toward anything that will burn, and toward you when you are angry.

hybrid.text: It burns because it is angry, and it is angry on your behalf.

settled.name: Wick-fiend
settled.text: A flame the size of a candle's with two horns and a temper. It has set fire to your bedding once and is not sorry.

paths.name: Coal-carrier
paths.text: It learned from you that fire is for carrying to somebody.

prongs.name: Blade-rider
prongs.text: It rides your blade to the foe and stays on the foe when the blade comes back.

finishes.name: Slag-fiend
finishes.text: Metal runs where it grips. What it has hold of is not armoured any more.

finishes.name: Pyre-dancer
finishes.text: It is never where the blow lands, and everywhere it has just been is alight.

prongs.name: Slung Coal
prongs.text: It goes out on your shot like a coal in a sling.

finishes.name: Falling Coal
finishes.text: Thrown high, it comes down white. The ground keeps the mark all season.

finishes.name: Fiend on the Hill
finishes.text: It burns on the hill above a dark post so the car can find you. Things that hate the light find it first.

prongs.name: Flare-up
prongs.text: When you are struck it doubles in size, and it does not come back down until something has paid.

finishes.name: Vendetta
finishes.text: It keeps a coal lit for each named beast that marked you. It blows on them at night.

finishes.name: Brush-burner
finishes.text: Hurt you in the green and it gets into the undergrowth. After that it is not one fiend.

paths.name: Grate-fiend
paths.text: It learned from you that a fire kept is worth more than a fire thrown.

prongs.name: Stove-devil
prongs.text: The cohort built it a stove so it would stop sleeping in the coal scuttle. It heats the whole dormitory out of spite.

finishes.name: Three-legged Stove
finishes.text: It walks on three iron legs and the party eats hot. Nobody who shared its fire has been left on the line.

finishes.name: Watchfire Fiend
finishes.text: Set it down at the post and it burns there till morning. What it lights, it guards.

prongs.name: Cauteriser
prongs.text: It closes your wounds the only way it knows. It works. You will not thank it at the time.

finishes.name: Scar-smith
finishes.text: Every wound of yours it sealed is a line of bright metal now. It is proud of the work.

finishes.name: Ward-flame
finishes.text: It burns along the edge of your wards, and nothing has yet wished to cross it twice.

prongs.name: Bedside Fiend
prongs.text: It burns low beside your bed, and brighter when something outside is thinking about the window.

finishes.name: Wake-candle
finishes.text: It burns at the hearth for the hall's dead. They come to it as moths would, if moths had names.

finishes.name: Thaw-fiend
finishes.text: Ice goes out ahead of it and the river lets you through. It hates the water and does it anyway.

paths.name: Bargain-fiend
paths.text: It learned from you that fire will do anything for a price, and so will most things.

prongs.name: Oath-scorch
prongs.text: Your Terms are burned into the air where you swore them. It tends the letters.

finishes.name: Mark of the Sworn
finishes.text: It has marked you, by agreement. While the Terms hold, the mark is cool. You know what happens otherwise.

finishes.name: Toll-fire
finishes.text: Each firing of your Pattern costs you, and it burns the cost for light. The chain shows brighter each time.

prongs.name: Bottle-fiend
prongs.text: It moved into a thing you dug out of a ruin, and comes out when the thing is rubbed, grumbling.

finishes.name: Fiend of the Stopped Bottle
finishes.text: The Archive wants the bottle back. It has explained to the Archive, at length, that it is not in.

finishes.name: Seal-burner
finishes.text: It melts the wax on every writ you carry and reseals it better. It has read them all.

prongs.name: Smoke-reader
prongs.text: It reads what is coming in its own smoke, and leans the way you should go.

finishes.name: Ash-reader
finishes.text: It sifts the ash at the mouth of the deep places and tells you who went in and did not come out.

finishes.name: Last Red Coal
finishes.text: In the Quiet it goes down to one red point and holds it. That point is the only warm thing for a mile.
